verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਦੀਨੋ ਸਾਚ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: pooran braham gur pooran kirapaa kai dheeno saach upadhes ridhai nihachal mat hai ||

en.bdb: Perfect Guru, embodiment of complete Lord becoming kind lodges true sermon in the heart of a disciple of the Guru. That makes him stable of intelligence and saves him from wanderings.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਨ ਜਲ ਮੀਨ ਭਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਰਬ ਮਈ ਪੈ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv leen jal meen bhe pooran sarab miee pai ghirat jugat hai ||

en.bdb: Engrossed in the word, his condition becomes like that of a fish enjoying the bliss of his surroundings. He then realises the presence of God in everyone just as fat, that is present in all milks.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੁਨੈ ਬੋਲੈ ਗੰਧ ਰਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: saach ridhai saach dhekhai sunai bolai ga(n)dh ras pooran parasapar bhaavanee bhagat hai ||

en.bdb: Lord resides in the heart of a Sikh who sees him everywhere, hears Him, enjoys His sweet smell, and relishes his name with his tongue. Feeling the presence of the perfect Lord, loving worship resides in his heart.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਦ੍ਰੁੁਮ ਸਾਖਾ ਪਤ੍ਰ ਫੂਲ ਫਲ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਤਿ ਹੈ ॥੨੭੬॥
verses.translit_en: pooran braham dhraum saakhaa patr fool fal ek hee anek mek satigur sat hai ||276||

en.bdb: True Guru who is eternal of form has dispensed this knowledge that just as the seed resides in the trees, plants, branches, flowers etc, one God who is perfect and all-knowing pervades in all. (276)
